In the real user flow (STD user with real JWT), no 404/422 happens; only the poll swap fires. This test artifact is not a bug.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bugs are fully fixed and verified. To re-run BUG2: (1) run `python /app/tests/inject_premium.py CD-BUGTEST-UPGRADE-001` (idempotent — revokes previous active + inserts new PREMIUM). (2) In v2.html console: `localStorage.setItem('caja.install.id.v1','CD-BUGTEST-UPGRADE-001'); localStorage.setItem('caja.license.v1', JSON.stringify({key:'<any>.<any>.<any>', type:'JWT', plan:'STD'})); await window.checkPlanUpgradeNow();` and check localStorage.getItem('caja.license.v1'). For BUG1, opening subscription-success.html with a fake session_id never reaches the upgradeBox (poll fails after 60s → error screen). To exercise the button, force display via JS: `document.getElementById('loadingBox').style.display='none';document.getElementById('successBox').style.display='block';document.getElementById('upgradeBox').style.display='block';document.getElementById('newClientBox').style.display='none';` — then click [data-testid=close-btn] and observe #closeHint appear.
rca of the issue: Original bugs: (1) subscription-success.html called window.close() without fallback UI — when Stripe redirect opens tab directly (not via JS window.open), browsers block window.close() silently and user was stuck. Fix: renamed button to 'Volver a MediCar Plus', attemptClose() tries close() and after 350ms if document is still not hidden shows a friendly hint to close with the X. (2) v2.html isPremiumLicense() only checked lic.type; auto-upgrade poll saves the new premium license with type='JWT' and plan='PREMIUM', so type check alone returned false → app kept showing Utilities as locked. Fix: check BOTH type AND plan for PRM/PREMIUM/TRIAL.
